summary: Hemmelig is a self-hosted end-to-end-encrypted secret-sharing app: secrets are client-side AES-256-GCM encrypted and stored as opaque binary blobs with metadata, view caps, optional viewer passwords and IP restriction; they self-destruct on their final read or on expiry. Around this core are registered user accounts (better-auth email/password with an admin role), one-time secret-request links, API keys, an invite-code gate, admin instance settings, file attachments, and visitor analytics. Credentials for the seed accounts: ada@hemmelig.test/pw-ada (admin), lin@hemmelig.test/pw-lin (user), noor@hemmelig.test/pw-noor (user).
_account_entity_why: fk_gravity points at User (6 FKs); the _auth_candidates heuristic (InstanceSettings with two bool 'credential-ish' columns) is wrong. Credentials live on User.email + User.password via better-auth; Account holds the provider-linked password hash. Sign-in verifies User, so the account entity is User.
